title: Majority disagreement under correlated noise
statement: For every correlation parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the probability that majority on $2k+1$ independent uniform signs changes under coordinatewise noise with correlation $\rho$ converges, as $k\to\infty$, to $\arccos(\rho)/\pi$.
